item.title: Kubernetes Homelab
item.description:
Built a self-managed Kubernetes cluster to experiment with infrastructure patterns.

Highlights

  • GitOps deployment using FluxCD
  • Helm-based application management
  • Repeatable cluster rebuilds
  • Adding Monitoring Dashboards

To simulate real-world infrastructure in a controlled environment and experiment safely.

item.title: About Me
item.description:
I’m a DevOps Engineer with hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure, automation, and platform engineering.

My work focuses on making systems reliable, scalable, and easy to operate.

Skills

  • AWS (IAM, SSM, EC2, networking)
  • Kubernetes
  • CI/CD (GitHub Actions, pipelines)
  • Infrastructure as Code
  • Linux and scripting

Approach

I treat infrastructure like software:

  • Everything is version controlled
  • Everything is automated
  • Everything is reproducible

What I’m Working On

Right now I’m building and iterating on a Kubernetes-based homelab using GitOps principles.
